headline: What Applies from January 1, 2027 for Pension Increases: Processing Time Cut from 500 Days to 40 Days
summary: The framework for the 2027 pension increase is expected to be finalized around November 20. Deputy Labour Minister Kostas Karagounis said the increase will be very large, and processing time is cut from 500 to 40 days.
why: Pension policy in Greece affects public spending and household consumption, two factors that matter for the country's fiscal and economic outlook.
